title: Highlight Champaran Satyagraha 1917
definition: The Champaran Satyagraha was the first civil disobedience movement led by Mahatma Gandhi in India, aimed at addressing the grievances of indigo cultivators against the exploitative 'Tinkathia' system imposed by European planters.
importanceInUpsc: It marks the transition of the Indian National Movement from elite-led constitutional agitation to mass-based grassroots mobilization, serving as a template for future Gandhian movements.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Highlight Champaran Satyagraha 1917.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Rise of Gandhi in South Africa
Evolution of the Indian National Congress
